toolParameters.name: tool_lowerRadius
toolParameters.expression: (tool_type == 'circle segment taper' ? (tool_upperRadius / 2) : ((tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' ? tool_upperRadius : ((tool_type == 'circle segment lens' ? (tool_diameter): (tool_diameter / 6))))))

toolParameters.name: tool_spindleSpeed
toolParameters.expression: tool_type == 'probe' ? 0 : tool_type == 'tap right hand' || tool_type == 'tap left hand' ? 500rpm : 5000rpm

parameters.name: tool_isTurning
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'turning boring' || tool_type == 'turning general' || tool_type == 'turning threading' || tool_type == 'turning grooving' || tool_type == 'turning custom'

parameters.name: tool_isMill
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'thread mill' || tool_type == 'form mill' || tool_type == 'tapered mill' || tool_type == 'radius mill' || tool_type == 'dovetail mill' || tool_type == 'face mill' || tool_type == 'bull nose end mill' || tool_type == 'slot mill' || tool_type == 'flat end mill' || tool_type == 'ball end mill' || tool_type == 'lollipop mill' || tool_type == 'chamfer mill' || tool_type == 'corner chamfer end mill' || tool_type == 'circle segment taper' || tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' || tool_type == 'circle segment oval' || tool_type == 'circle segment lens'

parameters.name: tool_isDrill
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'counter bore' || tool_type == 'boring bar' || tool_type == 'spot drill' || tool_type == 'counter sink' || tool_type == 'center drill' || tool_type == 'tap right hand' || tool_type == 'tap left hand' || tool_type == 'drill' || tool_type == 'reamer' || tool_type == 'block drill'

parameters.name: tool_isDepositing
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'laser powder' || tool_type == 'laser wire' || tool_type == 'electric arc wire'

parameters.name: tool_taperAngle
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'face mill') ? 0deg : ((tool_type == 'tapered mill') ? 10deg : ((tool_type == 'chamfer mill') ? 45deg : ((tool_type == 'circle segment taper') ? 20deg : ((tool_type == 'dovetail mill') ? 30deg : ((tool_type == 'center drill') ? 90deg : 5deg)))))

parameters.name: tool_shoulderDiameter
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'tapered mill' ? 2 * Math.tan(tool_taperAngle) * tool_fluteLength + tool_diameter : (tool_type == 'face mill' ? 2 * Math.tan(tool_taperAngle) * tool_fluteLength + tool_diameter : (tool_type == 'radius mill' ? tool_diameter + tool_cornerRadius * 2 : (tool_type == 'dovetail mill' ? tool_diameter - 2 * Math.tan(tool_taperAngle) * (tool_fluteLength - tool_cornerRadius * (1 + 1/Math.sin(tool_taperAngle))) - 2 * tool_cornerRadius : (tool_type == 'thread mill' ? tool_diameter - tool_threadPitch / Math.tan(tool_threadProfileAngle / 2) : (tool_type == 'chamfer mill' || tool_type == 'lollipop mill' ? (tool_diameter < tool_shaftDiameter ? tool_diameter : tool_shaftDiameter) : (tool_type == 'bull nose end mill' || tool_type == 'ball end mill' || tool_type == 'flat end mill' || tool_type == 'corner chamfer end mill' ? tool_diameter : ((tool_type == 'circle segment barrel') ? 6mm : ((tool_type == 'circle segment lens') ? 10mm : ((tool_type == 'circle segment taper') ? 16mm : (tool_shaftDiameter_enabled ? tool_shaftDiameter : tool_diameter)))))))))))

parameters.name: tool_profileRadius
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'circle segment taper' ? (tool_diameter * 31.25) : (tool_type == 'circle segment oval' ? (tool_diameter * 15) : (tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' ? (tool_diameter * 4) : (tool_diameter * 0.6))))

parameters.name: tool_lowerRadius
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'circle segment taper' ? (tool_upperRadius / 2) : ((tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' ? tool_upperRadius : ((tool_type == 'circle segment lens' ? (tool_diameter): (tool_diameter / 6))))))

parameters.name: view_orientation_mode
parameters.expression: isDrillingRefTrimming ? ((drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'axesZX' || drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'axesZY' || drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'axesXY' || drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'coordinateSystem' || drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'surfaceNormalX' || drillingReference.view_orientation_mode == 'surfaceNormalY') ? 'refOpSelection' : drillingReference.view_orientation_mode) : 'axesZX'

parameters.name: clearanceAreaHeight_mode
parameters.expression: isDrillingRefTrimming ? (drillingReference.clearanceAreaHeight_mode == 'from point' ? 'from reference operation' : drillingReference.clearanceAreaHeight_mode)  : 'from retract height'

parameters.name: clearanceAreaCylinderRadius_mode
parameters.expression: isDrillingRefTrimming ? (drillingReference.clearanceAreaCylinderRadius_mode == 'from sel max' ? 'from reference operation' : drillingReference.clearanceAreaCylinderRadius_mode) : 'from stock od'

parameters.name: clearanceAreaSphereRadius_mode
parameters.expression: isDrillingRefTrimming ? (drillingReference.clearanceAreaSphereRadius_mode == 'from sel max' ? 'from reference operation' : drillingReference.clearanceAreaSphereRadius_mode) : 'from stock od'

parameters.name: highFeedrate
parameters.expression: machine.defined && machine.maxFeedrate > 0 ? machine.maxFeedrate : Math.max(tool_feedCutting; Math.max(tool_feedEntry; tool_feedExit))
